# bitbucket_workspace_members (Data Source)

Lists every member of the workspace the provider is configured for.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "bitbucket_workspace_members" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier (the workspace slug).
- `members` (Attributes List) Every member of the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) Atlassian account ID of the member.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the member.
- `nickname` (String) Nickname of the member.
- `username` (String) Username of the member, if the account still has one.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the member.
